reviewNotes: ADMIT-BACKSTAGE. Current Telemach material supports an actively sold Free2Go prepaid product, current EUR 2 promotional starter price with EUR 5 credit, EUR 5/10/20 recharge vouchers, and an exact 90/180/270-day service lifecycle. General prepaid terms allow SIM disconnection after 270 days and make reactivation/porting unavailable 30 days after disconnection. EU/EEA RLAH domestic pricing has a separate Slovenia-residence/stable-ties registration requirement; China-specific SMS/OTP remains unverified.

events.outcome: Current Free2Go material establishes active acquisition, a EUR 5 recharge floor and the 90/180/270-day lifecycle; general prepaid terms allow SIM disconnection after day 270, while China OTP remains unverified.

data.acquisitionSummary: Telemach actively sells Free2Go physical prepaid SIMs through its stores and a wide Slovenian retail network. The current page shows a EUR 2 promotional starter price with EUR 5 preloaded credit. Prepaid recharge cards are EUR 5, 10 or 20 and can be applied by USSD at home or abroad.

keep.action: Recharge at least EUR 5 every 90 days to preserve continuous incoming and outgoing service. Days 91-180 are incoming-only; days 181-270 lose normal service. A recharge during days 91-270 restores service and restarts the 90-day period. The current prepaid terms allow Telemach to disconnect the SIM after 270 days without recharge; 30 days after disconnection the number cannot be reactivated or ported.

data.chinaActivation: Free2Go is a Slovenian physical-SIM acquisition route. Current provider material supports domestic retail purchase and prepaid roaming, but China-first activation and mainland-China OTP behavior are not established.
data.kyc: The current Free2Go sales page does not establish a general passport/no-KYC rule. For EU/EEA Roam-Like-At-Home domestic pricing, users activating from 1 October 2020 must register and prove habitual residence or stable ties to Slovenia; unregistered users can still roam in the EU/EEA with surcharges.
data.payment: Recharge vouchers are sold in EUR 5/10/20 denominations and can be redeemed by USSD at home or abroad. Telemach subscribers can also use Polni zame. Foreign-bank-card recharge success is not established.
data.roamingSms: Telemach explicitly directs prepaid users to its roaming country/operator tariff and documents EU/EEA roaming for Free2Go, including a separate registration rule for domestic-price RLAH. China-specific incoming SMS/OTP was not verified.
data.tariffSummary: Current Free2Go starter is displayed at EUR 2 with EUR 5 credit; EUR 5 is the lowest listed recharge. Full service lasts 90 days after recharge, followed by incoming-only to day 180 and restricted retention through day 270; Telemach may disconnect thereafter.
guideSteps: Buy Free2Go through a current Telemach/partner retail channel; treat the EUR 2 starter price as a current promotion, not a permanent floor.
Use EUR 5 recharge before each 90-day active-service deadline if continuous incoming/outgoing service matters.
For EU/EEA domestic-price roaming, follow Telemach’s RLAH registration/stable-ties rule; do not infer China OTP reliability.
